label: <DEL> step of long sequences that began with i
explanation: Fires only at the delimiter step (t == L), when the model is about to output original token 0. 95% of activations (97% of mass) are in sequences whose first token is i. A handful of the rest start with b or g. Fires almost only for L = 8 or 9 (94% of activations), with a few at L = 7 and one at L = 6; never at L <= 5. Never fires in the original or copy phases. Even so, only about 4.5% of long i-first sequences activate it, so it is a sparse, conjunctive detector whose extra conditions are diffuse and could not be pinned down. Activations are enriched when the second token is b (next output b; precision ~29% but recall ~21%), when the token just before <DEL> is c/d/e/v/w/h, and when the sequence contains digits. The top activations look like i b ... d <DEL>. Magnitude is mostly small (median 0.27, max 2.0); the largest examples have orig(1) = b.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=1 & out_tok=i (+3.73), out_tok=i (+2.90), orig2=q (+2.71), orig2=b (+2.09), orig3=3 (+2.04), orig2=3 (+2.03). Lower it: in_first=0 (-2.98), orig7=- (-2.78), orig6=- (-2.25), in_count=1 (-1.70).
